capabilities: share the note's .md file via the macOS share sheet
render the note to a text-based PDF and share it
share notes from iOS via the Web Share API
trigger sharing from ribbon, toolbar, context menus, or command palette
extras: Works only on macOS and iOS; intentionally inactive on Windows, Linux, and Android. Manifest carries an unreviewed-plugin notice. README explains why the plugin needs filesystem access (writing temp PDFs for the share sheet) and notes release assets have artifact attestations.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to hand a note to the operating system's share sheet (Messages, Mail, AirDrop) in one click.
summary: macOS/iOS plugin that shares the current note through the OS share sheet as the original Markdown file or as a rendered, text-based PDF.
